highlights: On iPhone, sign in again after you upgrade, and turn App lock on again in Settings if you used it.
Branch a chat from any finished agent answer: touch and hold it and choose Branch from here.
Dictate into the message box with the mic, and edit the words before you send.
Pins and chat folders now match the desktop app, and you can drag a chat to pin it or move it.
Your agents and recent chats show at once after a start, while the app connects to the server.
